front.title: YANG Model for BGP Segment Routing Policy

abstract.t: This document defines a YANG data model for the BGP Segment Routing (SR) Policy address families (RFC 9830). The model augments the BGP YANG model to add the IPv4 SR Policy (AFI, SAFI = 1, 73) and IPv6 SR Policy (AFI, SAFI = 2, 73) address families, including SR Policy- specific configuration, the SR Policy RIB, per-neighbor Adj-RIBs, and the decoded SR Policy candidate path information, such as preference, Binding SID, and segment lists.
